text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today we have a photo shoot for a<n>magazine.
They're running a special<n>feature on Seeking the
Pearl's<n>signature racewear.

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text:
That's great, Pearl! Next up, I'd like to<n>capture the
design on the back. Can<n>you turn around while
keeping your<n>face toward the camera?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... That's not a bad idea, but I'm<n>feeling
something different.

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text: Oh? Do go on.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Showing off my signature racewear<n>through
photographs is fine and all,<n>but I've envisaged a
little something<n>I'd like to try!

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? I'd be happy to try and<n>bring your vision
to life.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You see, I believe everything should<n>be a challenge!
I want to capture the<n>yet untried and unknown! I
want to<n>shine in a way nobody's ever shined
before!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I... see? Do you have a particular<n>scenario in mind
you want to try out?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: To put it simply, I want to do a<n>treasure hunt!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Swept up by Seeking the Pearl's<n>energy, we
somehow find ourselves<n>doing the shoot in the
forest.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'm going to discover a brand<n>new species
of plant right here in this<n>forest! Make sure you
don't miss the<n>shot!

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure I won't! But, uh... why<n>are we doing
a treasure hunt again?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Discovering a new species is<n>certainly an
interesting challenge, but<n>won't that be quite
difficult to do?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Sure, it won't be a walk in thepark—or the forest—but that's whatmakes it a challenge! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... I was hoping this was anew species, but I guess I waswrong. I've seen this flower before.

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text:
Phew... We've been walking around<n>and searching
for hours, but we<n>haven't found anything. I knew
this<n>wouldn't be easy...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Sure, but it's game over if you<n>give up! The
key is to never give up!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's crucial to hold on to the belief that<n>you'll
absolutely achieve what you<n>set out to do! Come
on, let's check<n>out that undergrowth over there!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... There doesn't seem to be<n>anything around
here. Let's head<n>deeper! Onward we go!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, we're heading even deeper into<n>the forest?!
Is there really a need to<n>keep going? We already
have more<n>than enough for the article...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I'm so sorry. You all must be<n>tired. Why don't
you take a break<n>here? If I find anything, I'll come
straight back!

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text:
What?! Are you planning on<n>continuing by
yourself?! You must be<n>exhausted as well, so why
don't we<n>call it a day and head ba—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Not a chance! I have to see my<n>challenge through to
the end. As long<n>as I'm wearing my signature
racewear, I can't give in!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Your signature racewear? I-is there<n>some kind of
special meaning behind<n>your costume's design?
Please tell<n>us!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, well, it's proof of my potential!<n>This outfit
represents my vision of<n>proving to the world
what's possible!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The eye-catching red base color<n>symbolizes my
passion for seeking<n>out possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And the stars on the front of the outfit<n>shine as
guiding lights of hope. In<n>other words, they're also
symbols of<n>my possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This challenge is my way of showing<n>readers the
meaning of my signature<n>racewear.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If I give up the search now, we won't<n>be able to
take any convincing<n>photos, and my feelings won't
be<n>conveyed. That's why I'm going to<n>accomplish
my goal, no matter how<n>difficult it may be!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl... I apologize for<n>failing to properly
understand your<n>vision!

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text:
We'll follow you to the ends of the<n>earth if that's
what it takes for your<n>challenge and determined
spirit to be<n>seen by the whole world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Thank you! I'll find that<n>undiscovered
species without fail!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This plant... It's very rare, isn't it?<n>There are so
many of them growing<n>in this area... Maybe, just
maaaybe,<n>there might be a new species hidden
among them!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ah! This... This one has differently<n>shaped leaves!
This must be an<n>undiscovered flower!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Let me look it up right away! Gasp! I-Ican't believe it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl successfully<n>discovered a new
species of flower!<n>By accomplishing such an
extremely<n>difficult task, she's realized part of<n>the
potential she preaches.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
All that's left now is to take the final<n>photo for the
interview. What's the<n>best way to tie my
completion of this<n>challenge to my vision in a way
that's easy for readers to empathize<n>with?

possibility.
How about going with a starry motif?
How about going with a starry motif?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
All that's left now is to take the final<n>photo for the
interview. What's the<n>best way to tie my
completion of this<n>challenge to my vision in a way
that's easy for readers to empathize<n>with?
choice_data_list:
Let's capture a pose that inspires a sense of
possibility.
How about going with a starry motif?
How about going with a starry motif?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You're right. That's my entire goal. I<n>want the world
to be a place where<n>people can fearlessly take on
challenges and never give up!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...I've made up my mind! I'm going to<n>go with a
pose that directly touches<n>the hearts of the readers!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Next, it's your turn to take on a<n>challenge!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The photograph of Seeking the Pearl<n>with the newly
discovered species of<n>flower later inspires courage
in a<n>great many people.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Nice idea, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
To properly convey the image of a<n>star, we'll need
to collaborate with<n>the night sky itself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the remainder of the shoot is<n>scheduled for
the evening.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Stars are like lights of hope, emblems<n>of
possibility... And this flower proves<n>those
possibilities to be true.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If you seek out challenges, the whole<n>world will
open before you! Just<n>follow my lead! Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, when the magazine is<n>published, the image of
Seeking the<n>Pearl shining beneath the starry sky
gives her fans courage and sparks a<n>huge buzz
with the media.
